responsibility: Master internal header for the C++ front end. It defines and declares the core cp-specific AST interfaces, helper classes like cp_expr, global tree indices and identifiers, language-specific flags and accessors for declarations/types/expressions (including concepts, contracts, overloads, lambdas, and modules), and the broad set of front-end utilities that tie together parsing, name lookup, type checking, diagnostics, and lowering.
same_name_distinction: This header builds on the tree codes from cp-tree.def by declaring the main C++ front-end interfaces, helper classes, globals, flags, and accessors/macros used throughout cp/*. Unlike cp-tree.def, it is not the tree-code definition table but the master API surface over those nodes and other C++ front-end state.
